7233.title: Runtime glyph animation and main-thread rendering
7233.rootCauseOneLine: The runtime glyph animates its SVG and drives repeated rendering work, but GPU-disabled automation cannot establish an SVG-specific compositor failure or a wrapper fix.
7233.proposedFix: Repeat the SVG/HTML comparison with GPU compositing enabled, then validate an HTML rotation container with a fail-before/pass-after rendering regression.
7233.caveats: Both clean runs used software-only headless Chrome 149; high-refresh CPU costs and compositor-only HTML rotation remain unverified. Probe source and raw measurements are inline in the HTML, per reports repository policy.
